name: Marvie
description: Marvie is a self-hosted video conferencing platform for teams and communities who want Zoom-grade calling without Zoom's friction. Anyone with a link joins instantly — no sign-up, no downloads, no waiting room unless the host wants one.

features.title: Link-based rooms
features.body: Cryptographically random, collision-checked room codes — no arbitrary URL can spawn a room, and nobody signs up on either end.

features.title: End-to-end encryption
features.body: Opt-in E2EE using per-call keys that never touch the server, keeping conversations private even from the platform itself.

features.title: Automatic cloud recording
features.body: Every call records server-side into cloud storage, independent of any participant's browser staying open.

audience.label: Remote Teams
audience.desc: Zoom-grade calls without seat licenses or install friction.

audience.label: Communities & Events
audience.desc: Instant link-based rooms for meetups, classes, and large gatherings.

audience.label: Hosts & Moderators
audience.desc: Waiting rooms, co-hosts, and bulk-admit controls built for scale.
